title: Benchmark as assessment, not full routine
summary: Benchmark playlists are best used to reveal strengths and weaknesses, then paired with fundamentals and weakness-specific work instead of replacing them.
cues: Use benchmarks to locate the gap before selecting training blocks
Retest after a block instead of mindlessly rerunning the same benchmark tasks
Separate assessment volume from improvement volume
failureModes: Grinding only benchmark tasks and calling it a full routine
Treating benchmark rank pushing as the same thing as broad aim improvement
